bank: fresh M50 OOD ep0 920000, CRN noise reused from each checkpoint's own M50 json

crowd_variant.name: retargeting_pedestrians
crowd_variant.why: the frozen HumanAgent.social_force_step parks a pedestrian forever once it is within 0.1 m of its sampled goal, so with [-2,8]^2 goals and 1.0-2.0 m/s OOD speeds most of the 40 pedestrians stop by step 30-60 and the late frames showed only the robot moving
crowd_variant.implementation: scoped context manager rebinding HumanAgent.social_force_step (frozen module never edited); on arrival a fresh goal is drawn with the constructor's own rules - uniform in [-2,8]^2, at least 2.0 m from the robot goal (6,6), at least 1.5 m of travel - using the agent's own RNG so the scenario stays reproducible
crowd_variant.goal_occlusion_check: no pedestrian can park on the goal (2.0 m keep-out); nearest pedestrian to the goal at the end of ep920036 was 2.82 m
crowd_variant.status: VIDEO ONLY - rollouts under this variant are not the fixed-bank evaluation and are never reported as a metric

why_this_episode: under the re-targeting crowd only 3 of the 50 bank episodes keep the champion successful at all three gammas (920011, 920020, 920027); 920011 has no PRE failure (no contrast) and 920020 has Kazuki colliding at every gamma even at w_s=1.4, so 920027 is the only pick that shows all three behaviours plus visibly different champion routes per gamma (gamma 0.1 takes a wide S detour, gamma 1.0 runs nearly straight)

kazuki_calibration.honest_note: the requested story (Kazuki succeeds only at gamma 0.1) could not be produced by tuning: Kazuki's guidance is gamma-independent, so its per-gamma outcome pattern is driven by the CFM base samples, not by w_safe; w_s=0.5 even inverts the pattern. The delivered video reports what the rollouts actually did.
